positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: Rated 93% by the Council For Citizens Against Government Waste
Voted against H.R. 4521 "America COMPETES Act of 2022"

"Inflation is a tax on all Americans," said Rep. Mann. "For two years, the Biden Administration enjoyed almost no oversight from the Democrat-controlled House and Senate as it burned through taxpayer dollars with sweeping executive orders. The REIN IN Inflation Act, however, will force the Administration to publish the inflationary impact of its executive orders before enacting them. From canceling the Keystone XL Pipeline to pushing socialist "Green New Deal" regulations on small businesses, President Biden must be held accountable for the harmful impact of his failed agenda, which continues to drive up the prices of goods, gas, and groceries."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "For months, the Biden Administration wasted time on their student debt ploy all while inflation, interest rates, & housing costs reached record highs. We need to rein in President Biden’s reckless spending & get the economy back on track."
Rated 0% by the National Education Association

"President Biden’s approval rating with young Americans is at 36%, and his efforts to cancel mass student debt is nothing more than a political ploy," said Rep. Mann. "We need a well-developed and long-term solution that will address the high cost of education in America. With our national debt eclipsing $32 trillion just a few days ago, and President Biden deficit-spending about $1 trillion every year, now is not the time to erase debt that student borrowers knowingly took on. Student loan debt cancellation punishes taxpayers who either didn’t go to college or who found ways to pay for their education rather than taking on debt. President Biden’s veto, and his refusal to listen to elected representatives in Congress, shows just how far his Administration is willing to go in using hard-earned taxpayer dollars for political gain."
Voted against H.R. 2547 "Comprehensive Debt Collection Improvement Act"
